components.css: .ds-discipline{color:var(--bone,#fafafa);border-block:1px solid var(--rule,#343434);font:400 14px/1.6 Archivo,sans-serif}.ds-discipline summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;cursor:pointer;padding-block:25px;list-style:none}.ds-discipline summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-discipline summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--red,#e0231f);outline-offset:5px}.ds-discipline h3{font:600 clamp(25px,3vw,40px)/1.2 Syne,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.025em;width:46%;margin:0}.ds-discipline summary:hover h3{color:#d4d4d4}.ds-discipline span,.ds-discipline p{color:var(--muted,#aaa)}.ds-discipline svg{width:24px;height:24px;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;margin-left:auto;transition:transform .2s ease}.ds-discipline[open] svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-discipline p{margin:0 0 0 46%;padding:0 24px 28px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-discipline summary{flex-wrap:wrap;position:relative;padding-right:36px;gap:6px}.ds-discipline h3{width:100%;font-size:30px}.ds-discipline svg{position:absolute;right:0;top:32px}.ds-discipline p{margin-left:0;padding:0 30px 24px 0}}@media(max-width:370px){.ds-discipline h3{font-size:24px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-discipline svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Preserve the August 2026 identity: a planted double-chevron, geometric wordmark, black and bone surfaces, and sparing red. The website is direct and confident, with readable supporting copy and open space for parents and first-time trainees.

This document records the finished website, not a replacement identity. Brand authority is `brand/brand-guidelines.html`; implementation authority is `apps/web/site/src/styles/global.css`, `fonts.css`, `layouts/Base.astro` and `pages/index.astro`. Product facts belong in `PRODUCT.md`. Review disposition is recorded in `apps/web/site/REVIEW.md`.

The public FAQ uses native disclosures with confirmed monthly unlimited pricing and a free first session. The live form collects email and phone, reports server-validation failures and retains values on errors. The private React inbox at apps/web/dash uses a compact 34px Syne title (26px mobile), Archivo controls, an in-memory access key and a horizontally scrollable table. No demo records ship.
keyCharacteristics: Large uppercase Syne headings with quiet Archivo copy.
Flat black surfaces, open ruled rows and a bone timetable band.
Original chevron and wordmark geometry; restrained SVG interaction icons.
dos: **Do** retain the supplied August logo geometry, fonts and black/red/bone hierarchy.
**Do** use functional greys for readable secondary information and control states.
**Do** preserve keyboard focus, native disclosure/form semantics and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: **Don't** add gradients, glow, decorative card grids or replacement logo artwork.
**Don't** use red body copy or obscure provisional and disabled states.
